items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: Michael Climes would play piano. He'd play drums and then Charles went to play on the saxophone. And we'd play together

ctx.x: So you know when that just do the. Well we wouldn't do this on these jobs. When my uncle would get a job, and sometimes he was lucky enough to get a job where I could use the whole family. Say nine men. He'd use my cousin Charles, myself and him. Three saxophones and my two cousins played trumpet. And he'd get a trombone player. I believe Homer Eugene would play trombone. And he liked brother groups. I noticed that because he'd get Mac Lane and his son to play banjo and bass. And he'd get the Eugene brothers to…
